# Iris UI

Token-driven, cross-framework (React, Vue, SolidJS, Svelte) UI component library.

Frameworks: react, vue, solid, svelte. Import components from `@iris-ui/react` or `@iris-ui/vue` or `@iris-ui/solid` or `@iris-ui/svelte`.

## Architecture
- Layer 0 — Theme System: Design tokens, applyTheme, theme store (CSS variables).
- Layer 1 — Meta Primitives: Low-level, single-purpose building blocks.
- Layer 2 — Composite Components: Higher-level interactive components.
- Layer 3 — Layouts: Structural layout components.
- Layer 4 — System Skeletons: Page / section skeleton scaffolds.
- Behaviors: Orthogonal interaction behaviors (hotkeys, click-outside, drag).

## Data & Resilience Primitives (framework-agnostic, from @iris-ui/core)
- `createDisposableScope` — Lifecycle teardown (destroy, child scopes, error isolation).
- `createEventBus` — Typed pub/sub for cross-plugin and cross-controller communication.
- `createQueryCache` — Async fetch dedup with TTL + stale-while-revalidate (SWR).
- `createCircuitBreaker` — Failure isolation: trips after N failures, resets after cooldown.
- `createRateLimiter` — Token-bucket rate limiting with burst capacity.
- `createResilientFetcher` — Composes cache + circuit breaker + rate limiter into one hardened async fetcher.
- `createOutbox` — Offline-first, durable FIFO mutation queue with at-least-once delivery.
- `createReconnectingSource` — Realtime push transport with exponential-backoff reconnection.
- `createDataSource` — Unified data engine: fetch + paginate + sort + filter + select + mutate. Optionally wraps resilient fetcher and outbox.
- `createResourceController` — Higher-level CRUD list controller (Table/ProTable).

## Plugin Ecosystem (12 plugins)
Install plugins as separate packages; activate via <IrisProvider plugins={[…]}>.
Import components from `@iris-ui/plugin-{name}/{framework}`.
- `@iris-ui/plugin-locale-zh` — Simplified-Chinese (zh-CN) message pack for all Iris UI i18n keys.
- `@iris-ui/plugin-editor` — CodeMirror 6 code editor (SQL/JSON/JS/plain) with inline diff view.
- `@iris-ui/plugin-pro-table` — vxe-table-style CRUD data table with sorting, filtering, inline editing, column resize, and row virtualization.
- `@iris-ui/plugin-charts` — Zero-dependency, token-themed SVG charts: line, area, bar, sparkline.
- `@iris-ui/plugin-form-builder` — Schema-driven form builder — render a validated form from a declarative schema.
- `@iris-ui/plugin-notifications` — Persistent notification center with inbox, unread count, mark-read, dismiss.
- `@iris-ui/plugin-admin` — Admin panel extensions: page layouts, user management widgets.
- `@iris-ui/plugin-calendar` — Calendar widget with month/week views and event display.
- `@iris-ui/plugin-dashboard` — Dashboard grid layouts with draggable cards and responsive breakpoints.
- `@iris-ui/plugin-kanban` — Kanban board with drag-and-drop columns and cards.
- `@iris-ui/plugin-markdown` — Markdown editor (CodeMirror) and rendered preview with syntax highlighting.
- `@iris-ui/plugin-query-builder` — Visual query/filter builder with rule groups, operators, and value inputs.

## Components (151 total — 151 in all 4 frameworks; react 151, vue 151, solid 151, svelte 151)

### behaviors (6)
- IrisClickOutside [react/solid/svelte/vue]
  Behavior wrapper: fires `onOutside` when a pointerdown happens outside the wrapped child tree. Renders a thin `<span style="display:contents">` to capture the child's bounding box without disrupting layout.
  props: onOutside, disabled?, ignore?, children?
  events: onOutside
  slots: default
  quality: 4 props, 1 events
- IrisHotkey [react/solid/svelte/vue]
  Behavior wrapper: binds a global keyboard shortcut while children are mounted. Renderless — returns children verbatim (no extra DOM).
  props: shortcut, onTrigger, disabled?, allowInInputs?, scope?, children?
  events: onTrigger
  slots: default
  quality: 6 props, 1 events
- IrisLongPress [react/solid/svelte/vue]
  props: holdDelay?, onLongPress, disabled?, children?
  events: onLongPress
  slots: default
  quality: 4 props, 1 events
- IrisMovable [react/solid/svelte/vue]
  Behavior wrapper: makes its child draggable. Position is `transform`-based (no layout thrash). The whole wrapper drags by default; pass `byHandle` and put `data-iris-movable-handle=""` on a descendant (e.g. a title bar) to restrict the drag origin.
  props: position?, defaultPosition?, onPositionChange?, onDragStart?, onDragEnd?, bounds?, byHandle?, disabled?, children?
  events: onPositionChange, onDragStart, onDragEnd
  slots: default
  quality: 9 props, 3 events
- IrisResizable [react/solid/svelte/vue]
  Behavior wrapper: makes its child resizable via 8-direction handles. The wrapper itself is `display: inline-block; position: relative` so the child can be ANY element (no need for the child to know it's wrapped). Handles are absolutely positioned over the wrapper's edges.
  props: size?, defaultSize?, onSizeChange?, onResizeStart?, onResizeEnd?, handles?, minWidth?, minHeight?, maxWidth?, maxHeight?, keepAspect?, disabled?, children?
  events: onSizeChange, onResizeStart, onResizeEnd
  slots: default
  quality: 13 props, 3 events
- IrisSortable [react/solid/svelte/vue]
  props: items, onReorder, getKey?, children?, className?, style?, disabled?
  events: onReorder
  slots: default
  quality: 7 props, 1 events

### other (7)
- IrisAdminBreadcrumb [react/solid/svelte/vue]
  Breadcrumb trail for the admin header, driven by a `NavNode[]` ancestor chain. The last crumb is the current page (auto-marked `aria-current` by IrisBreadcrumb); earlier crumbs are clickable and call `onSelect(key, node)`. React port of the Vue `IrisAdminBreadcrumb`.
  props: trail, showIcon?, hideSingle?, separator?, onSelect?
  events: onSelect
  quality: 5 props, 1 events
- IrisAdminLayout [react/solid/svelte/vue]
  The CMS / admin shell — a Vben-style, router-agnostic, data-driven layout that composes IrisSidebarLayout + IrisHeaderLayout with the admin nav pieces. One `menus` tree drives the collapsible sidebar nav, the header breadcrumb, and (when a `tabs` store is passed) the multi-tab bar; `activeKey` is the current page. The host owns routing: react to `onSelect` / `onActiveKeyChange` and render the page via the children render-prop (wrap it in keep-alive keyed by `tabs.cacheKey` for Vben-style tab caching).
  props: menus, activeKey?, defaultActiveKey?, onActiveKeyChange?, collapsed?, defaultCollapsed?, onCollapsedChange?, mode?, appTitle?, tabs?, showBreadcrumb?, sidebarWidth?, collapsedWidth?, logo?, toolbar?, footer?, onSelect?, children?
  events: onActiveKeyChange, onCollapsedChange, onSelect
  slots: toolbar, footer
  quality: 18 props, 3 events
- IrisAdminTabs [react/solid/svelte/vue]
  Vben-style multi-tab bar over a shared {@link TabsNav} store. Each open page is a closable chip; clicking activates (`onChange`), the × closes, and a trailing actions dropdown runs Refresh / Close / Close-others / Close-all on the active tab. The store owns the tab list + active key; the host watches it to sync routing + keep-alive.
  props: nav, onChange?, onClose?, onRefresh?
  events: onChange, onClose, onRefresh
  quality: 4 props, 3 events
- IrisErrorBoundary [react/solid/svelte/vue]
  Catches errors thrown while rendering its subtree and switches to a fallback UI instead of crashing the whole React tree. Exposes `reset()` (passed to the fallback) that clears the error and re-attempts rendering the children.
  props: children?, fallback?, onError?
  events: onError
  slots: default, fallback
  quality: 3 props, 1 events
- IrisI18nProvider [react/solid/svelte/vue]
  Makes a locale + message dictionary available to descendant components via `useI18n`. Either pass `locale` / `messages` (an instance is created and kept in sync) or a pre-built `i18n` instance you control externally.
  props: locale?, messages?, i18n?, autoDirection?, directionTarget?, children?
  slots: default
  quality: 6 props, 0 events
- IrisNavMenu [react/solid/svelte/vue]
  Data-driven nested navigation menu — the sidebar nav of the admin shell. Renders a normalized `NavNode[]` tree as an accordion of expandable branches and selectable leaves; the active leaf and its ancestor branches are highlighted, and the active branch trail auto-expands. Router-agnostic: takes `activeKey`, calls `onSelect(key, node)`; the host owns navigation.
  props: items, activeKey?, expandedKeys?, defaultExpandedKeys?, collapsed?, ariaLabel?, onSelect?, onExpandedKeysChange?
  events: onSelect, onExpandedKeysChange
  quality: 8 props, 2 events
- IrisProvider [react/solid/svelte/vue]
  The single unified entry point. Runs the plugins, applies their additive token layer over the active theme, merges their messages under the user's, and exposes their stores via `PluginStoreContext`. The existing Theme / Skin / I18n providers are composed in around it.
  props: theme?, skin?, dir?, locale?, messages?, plugins?, target?, children?
  slots: default
  quality: 8 props, 0 events

  props: steps, open?, defaultOpen?, onChange?, onClose?, onFinish?, style?, className?
  events: onChange, onClose, onFinish
  quality: 8 props, 3 events
- IrisTransfer [react/solid/svelte/vue]
  Dual-list transfer: move items between an "available" and a "selected" pane via per-item checkboxes and the ›/‹ buttons. Controlled or uncontrolled (`value` = the selected values), with optional per-pane search and a select-all header. Built on native checkboxes for accessibility.
  props: options, value?, defaultValue?, onValueChange?, titles?, searchable?, disabled?, style?, className?
  events: onValueChange
  slots: titles
  quality: 9 props, 1 events
- IrisTree [react/solid/svelte/vue]
  Tree control. Renders a hierarchy of `IrisTreeNode`s with expand/collapse, single/multi selection, and optional lazy-loaded children. WAI-ARIA Tree pattern: root `role="tree"`, each node `role="treeitem"`, roving tabindex.
  props: nodes, expanded?, defaultExpanded?, onExpandedChange?, selected?, defaultSelected?, onSelectedChange?, selectionMode?, checkable?, defaultChecked?, onCheckedChange?, ariaLabel?, loading?, error?, emptyState?, loadingState?, errorState?, style?, className?
  events: onExpandedChange, onSelectedChange, onCheckedChange
  slots: emptyState, loadingState, errorState
  quality: 19 props, 3 events
- IrisTreeSelect [react/solid/svelte/vue]
  Hierarchical single-select: a trigger that opens a `role="tree"` dropdown with expand/collapse toggles. Selecting a node sets the value and closes. Controlled or uncontrolled; closes on select, Escape, or outside click.
  props: options, value?, defaultValue?, onValueChange?, defaultExpanded?, placeholder?, disabled?, invalid?, size?, id?, ariaDescribedby?, style?, className?
  events: onValueChange
  quality: 13 props, 1 events
- IrisVirtualScroll [react/solid/svelte/vue]
  Virtual scroller. Renders only the visible window of items plus a configurable buffer above and below. Vertical-only. `itemHeight` may be a fixed number, a `(index) => px` function for variable-height rows, or `'auto'` to measure rendered rows.
  props: items, itemHeight, estimatedItemHeight?, height?, buffer?, keyOf?, renderItem, onScroll?, onRangeChange?, style?, className?
  events: onScroll, onRangeChange
  slots: renderItem
  quality: 11 props, 2 events
- IrisVisuallyHidden [react/solid/svelte/vue]
  Visually-hidden content: present in the accessibility tree (read by screen readers) but clipped from view — for labels, live-region announcements, and extra context. Forwards attributes like `aria-live` / `role`.
  quality: 0 props, 0 events
- IrisWatermark [react/solid/svelte/vue]
  Watermark: overlays tiled, rotated text over its content — for confidential or branded surfaces. The overlay is `aria-hidden`, non-selectable, and `pointer-events: none`, so it never interferes with the underlying UI. Built from structured `<span>` nodes (no raw HTML / canvas / SVG-string injection).
  props: content, children?, rotate?, fontSize?, color?, opacity?, gap?, style?, className?
  slots: default
  quality: 9 props, 0 events
